name: codex-issue-memory
description: Local-first issue memory MCP package for Codex with SQLite-backed retrieval and operational tooling.

interface.shortDescription: Local-first Codex issue-memory MCP with retrieval, feedback, and operational controls.
interface.longDescription: codex-issue-memory stores reusable debugging knowledge in local SQLite and provides ranked issue matches, feedback workflows, preferences, guardrails, and health/operations tooling for stable daily use in Codex and local agent setups.
